qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Industry-leading cost efficiency in DACH retail banking (cost-to-income ratio ~32-34%) and sticky retail deposit franchise. Defended by radical operating simplicity and digital origination, though lending products remain commoditized.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 4 (CAP = 5, REJECT). Cost-leader Austrian/DACH retail lender (CIR ~33%, RoTCE ~26%) executing disciplined bolt-on M&A (e.g. Knab in the Netherlands). However, retail and SME banking is an interest-rate-dependent spread business without pricing power over the long cycle, facing NII contraction as ECB interest rates decline.
qualitative.evidence: FY24 net profit was €760M (EPS €9.60) with RoTCE of 26.0% and cost-to-income ratio of 33.5% (FY23 net profit €683M, RoTCE 25.0%). Completed acquisition of Dutch digital bank Knab in Nov 2024. Despite exceptional operational efficiency, baseline persistence for regional spread-lenders is low, capping CAP at 5 years.
